description: Where and when a rule runs: a descriptor on every assignment, `__post_init__` once at construction, a property for one attribute.
An immutable object compared by value, such as a money amount or a SKU; a frozen dataclass is hashable and safe to share.
Instances × measured bytes per instance, compared with the budget before choosing a layout.
Two features that work alone but conflict together, such as `dataclass(slots=True)` replacing descriptor fields with plain slots.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
